entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while I connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David, agent ID 304. How can I help you today?
Finally! I've been on hold for ten minutes. I bought these expensive cycling shoes from you a month ago and they are complete and utter garbage. I want my money back, now.
I can certainly look into that for you, and I apologize for the wait time. To get started, can I have your order number?
It's VF88602. Don't waste my time, David. I expect a full refund. This is ridiculous.

Thank you. I'm pulling that up now. I see the order for the Mountain Bike Shoes. I'm sorry to hear you're not satisfied with them. So I can best assist you, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

A preference? Do I have a preference for getting painful blisters on my heels? No! I tried adjusting the cleats, I tried different socks, nothing works. These things are torture devices, not shoes. I'm not troubleshooting this, I want to return them.
I understand your frustration completely. Getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Let me just confirm the delivery date here...

What does the date matter? Are you trying to find a way out of this? Because if you tell me I can't return them, I'm lighting up your social media with pictures of my feet and I want to speak to your manager right now.

No, not at all, sir. I just need to verify the details for the return authorization. I see they were delivered 37 days ago. Let me just check our policy... Okay, yes. According to our policy, you're well within the 90-day return window.
Oh. So you can process the refund then?

Absolutely. I can process that for you right away. I've just initiated the return in our system. I'm sending a pre-paid return label to the email address on file. Just print it out, attach it to the original box, and drop it at any post office. Once we receive the shoes, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method.
Okay. Well, that's what I wanted. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope you have a better day.
